channel.title: The Kimberley Echo - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kimberley Echo (kimberleyecho.com.au)

item.title: Wyndham weather radar to be down for next three months after lightning strike on Christmas Day
item.description: The Wyndham weather radar is expected to be out of action for the next three months after it was struck by lightning on Christmas Day, the Bureau of Meteorology says.

item.title: Lake Argyle Swim gearing up for its biggest year yet in 2026
item.description: The Lake Argyle Swim is gearing up for its biggest year yet, with more than 700 people coming from across the country for the iconic Kimberley event on May 2.

item.title: EPA approves contentious fracking drilling campaign by US company in West Kimberley
item.description: The Environmental Protection Authority said Bennett Resources, part of Black Mountain Energy, could sink the exploration and appraisal wells subject to strict environmental conditions.

item.title: Cottoning on: Ord agronomist Emily O’Shannessy selected for prestigious leadership Program
item.description: The East Kimberley’s burgeoning cotton industry has taken another step forward, with a Kununurra-based agronomist selected to take part in a prestigious leadership program run by Cotton Australia.

item.title: Kitchen upgrade strengthens Mulan community
item.description: Mulan Aboriginal Corporation’s community kitchen upgrade strengthens community and connection

item.title: Flood advice issued for West and North Kimberley rivers
item.description: A Flood Advice has been issued for communities along the West Kimberley and North Kimberley rivers.

item.title: Lake Kununurra lowered for maintenance
item.description: Water Corporation will be lowering water levels in Lake Kununurra end of January to late February for essential maintenance

item.title: Survey shows people cutting back on air-conditioners as WA records third-hottest year
item.description: WA has recorded its third-hottest year on record but a survey has shown soaring power bills are forcing people to turn off their air-conditioners.

item.title: North West leaders share their visions for 2026
item.description: Regional leaders have shared their plans for the new year.

item.title: Callum Ah Chee making waves at Adelaide Crows preseason training
item.description: Two-time AFL premiership player Callum Ah Chee who hails from Derby in the West Kimberley is making waves at his new football club, the Adelaide Crows, impressing his new teammates at pre-season training
